title: Exponential package document (JSON format 1.x)
description: A document of an Exponential package in the JSON format: package.json (kind definition) or the JSON form of one of the package's XML documents (kind document). The XML is mirrored element for element in JsonML. Reference: doc/bc/6.0/package-json-format.md

source.description: The XML document this one mirrors, relative to the package directory (package.xml, ezcontentclass/class-article.xml ...).

checksums.description: package.json only: the SHA-256 (lower-case hex) of every other file of the package, by its path relative to the package directory.

attributes.description: The element's attributes, namespace declarations (xmlns, xmlns:prefix) first, in document order. Values are strings.

element.description: [name, {attributes}?, child...]: an XML element in JsonML. The attributes object, when there is one, is the second item.

special.description: ["#comment", text], ["#cdata", text], ["#xml", "<rich text XML>"] or ["?target", data].
